questions.question: Two positions of the same cubical block are shown. When one of the faces W is at the top, which face will be at the bottom?
questions.questionHtml: Two positions of the same cubical block are shown. When one of the faces W is at the top, which face will be at the bottom?
questions.solution:
Explanation:

In the given figure we can see two positions of a cube which shows that X is adjacent to A, B, Y, and Z which means we can see all four adjacent sides of X. 
 
Since there are only 6 sides and we know 5 of them it is very easy to calculate that the bottom face is W which means W is opposite to X.
If W is on the top then it is obvious that the face on the bottom will be X.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Additional Information

  • Dices are of two types :
  1.  Standard Dice
  2. Non-Standard Dice.
  • Dice has:-
  1. faces = 6
  2. sides = 12
  3. corners = 8
  • Two opposite faces are never seen together.
  • Adjacent faces are never the opposite of each other.

questions.question: Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '1'.
questions.questionHtml: Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '1'.
questions.solution:
When we compare both the figures we get,

Method 1: In an ideal dice sum of two opposite sides of the dice is 7.

So, opposite pairs could be: (1, 6), (2, 5), and (3, 4).

According, to this concept we can say that, "6 is the number on the face opposite to the face showing 1".

Method 2: When the two figures of the same dice are given in which two numbers are common:

Then the other two numbers on two different figures of the same dice will be opposite to each other.

According, to this concept we can say that, "6 is the number on the face opposite to the face showing 1".

Method 3: We observe that when we move the dice downwards or anticlockwise then digit 6 is visible at the top which was behind the dice and digit 1 will move downward which was on the front side of the figure of the dice. So, 6 is the number on the face opposite to the face showing 1.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
